entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Diana, I want to return this jersey I bought. This is ridiculous. I've been a customer for years and the quality has just gone down the drain.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can I have your order number?

Order number? I don't have it in front of me! Can't you just look up my name? This is taking forever. I want to return this jersey, it's the wrong size and it's way too tight. I need an exchange or my money back, now.

I understand your frustration. Of course, I can try to find your order with your name and email address. To be sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me a bit more about the issue? Is it a technical fault with the jersey or a preference issue?

It's not a preference! The sizing chart is a lie. This thing is way too tight, I can barely breathe in it. I need to exchange it for a larger size or get a refund. If you can't do this, I want to speak to your manager. I'm about to leave a one-star review everywhere.
I understand completely. Let me see what I can do. I've found your order for the ClubFit Jersey, placed about two months ago. Let me just review our current return policy.
Two months, one month, who cares? Your website says returns are easy. So make it easy or get me someone who can.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I've checked the policy, and you are absolutely right. Since your purchase was made 56 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now. Would you prefer a refund or an exchange for a different size?
Oh. Seriously? You can just do it? Okay, well... that's better. A refund would be great, actually. I'll just re-order later.

A refund it is. I have just initiated that for you. You will receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label to send the jersey back to us. Once our warehouse receives it, the full refund will be processed to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. That was... actually helpful. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
